currentObservations.title: 数据智能平台出现标准化与评测指标并行体现
currentObservations.summary: 相关证据显示，数据智能平台能力建设同时出现标准化参与和技术效果评测两类指标：上海人工智能标准体系提出到2028年牵头或参与国家标准10项以上；BatchDAG在12个转录类查询受控实验中取得3.74/5质量评分。该观察为跨来源并行信号，表明该对象相关能力评价同时涉及规范建设与实际处理效果。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 新观察补充了现有治理与效率观察，显示数据智能平台相关能力不仅体现为处理效率指标，也出现标准化参与目标与技术评测指标并行呈现的证据关系。

evidence_cards.source_quote: In controlled experiments on 12 transcript-heavy queries, BatchDAG (3.74/5) achieves quality comparable to an expert-designed pipeline (3.25/5)
国家标准 10 项以上

currentObservations.title: 数据智能平台出现证据链与治理能力并行体现
currentObservations.summary: 相关证据显示，数据智能平台能力建设同时体现数据处理优化与治理约束：BatchDAG通过实体感知批处理将LLM调用减少最高47倍，并达到77%的转录证据率；同时，企业侧已有58%表示已运行或正在建设受治理语义层。该观察为同对象相关指标与跨来源并行信号，说明数据智能平台能力包含执行效率与可信治理两类并行要求。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 新增事实显示数据智能平台相关能力同时涉及数据处理效率、结果可追溯性与治理层建设，与已有治理和实时约束观察不同，补充了Agent数据处理链路侧的结构信号。

evidence_cards.source_quote: superior provenance (77% transcript evidence rate vs. 46-60% for baselines)
A key optimization, entity-aware batching, groups rows by logical entity before fan-out, reducing LLM calls by up to 47x.
Well over half of enterprises (58%) either run a governed semantic layer in production (25%) or are piloting and building one (34%)

currentObservations.title: 数据智能平台出现治理与实时约束并行体现
currentObservations.summary: 相关材料显示，数据智能平台能力建设同时包含AI就绪数据标准化要求与实时服务约束：Snowflake框架提出6个AI就绪因素及60多项可衡量要求，向量搜索需要个位数毫秒级延迟。与此同时，企业Agent安全实践中已有54%的受访企业报告确认发生过Agent安全事件，显示数据智能能力与治理约束并行体现。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 新观察补充了现有“数据发现、连接、语义管理和治理控制架构”判断，增加了AI就绪数据治理、实时检索性能和Agent安全约束三个已显现维度。

evidence_cards.source_quote: 向量搜索需要个位数毫秒级延迟
我们将「AI 就绪」拆解为六个可衡量因素——6C：Clean（干净）、Contextual（具备上下文）、Consumable（可直接使用）、Current（保持最新）、Correlated（可追溯关联）、Compliant（合规）
54%, have already had a confirmed agent security incident (18%) or a near-miss caught before harm (36%)

facts.subject: deployment_model
facts.statement: Every customer runs on a dedicated, fully siloed, private AWS cloud instance with its own private database; Outmarket uses a single-tenant architecture so each client's knowledge graph is isolated.

evidence_cards.source_quote: Every customer runs on a dedicated, fully siloed, private AWS cloud instance with its own private database. Outmarket's single tenant architecture keeps each client's knowledge graph in its own instance so intelligence is never pooled, diluted, or shared across customers.

facts.subject: incident_rate_by_credential_posture
facts.statement: Organizations with any credential sharing in the agent fleet had a 63.5% incident-or-near-miss rate (47 of 74), versus 40.9% (9 of 22) where every agent carries its own scoped identity.
facts.effective_period: Past 12 months from the June 2026 survey

evidence_cards.source_quote: Organizations with credential sharing anywhere in the fleet were hit — with an incident or a near-miss in the past twelve months — at 63.5% (47 of 74). Organizations where every agent carries its own scoped identity were hit at 40.9% (9 of 22).

facts.subject: first_party_agents

evidence_cards.source_quote: It governs both first-party agents built inside Snowflake, such as Snowflake CoWork and CoCo, and third-party agents built on external platforms.

facts.subject: dual_attribution_principle
facts.statement: Cortex AI Gateway uses dual attribution, logging both the verified non-human identity of the agent and the specific human who authorized the task, to enforce task-scoped access.

evidence_cards.source_quote: By logging both the verified non-human identity of the agent and the specific human who authorized the task, we ensure task-scoped access and complete auditability for every action taken across the enterprise

facts.subject: cost_governance_architecture
facts.statement: Cortex AI Gateway provides IT and finance teams a unified view of AI consumption, attributes costs to specific teams, agents, or workloads, and enforces spending limits.

evidence_cards.source_quote: It gives IT and finance teams a unified view of AI consumption, attributes costs to the specific teams, agents, or workloads driving them, and enforces spending limits before bills spiral.
